title: Sharp upper limit on a global one-epoch energy constant
statement: For A=mu I+(1-mu)11^T, the parallel Rayleigh quotient gives gamma(A)/mu <= [n-(n-1)mu](1-mu^(2n))/[n mu(1-mu^2)]. Consequently no dimension-uniform inequality K(A)>=c mu A^{-1} can hold for c>1/2.
assumptions: The limit n to infinity is taken at fixed mu<1 before mu tends upward to one
open_objections: This is an upper bound on the best possible global constant; it does not prove the surviving c=1/2 inequality.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
